subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving exponential growth/decay or function transformations, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student models a realistic scenario (population growth, investment, radioactive decay) using an exponential function
exercise.pictorial: Student graphs the scenario before interpreting the solution's real-world meaning
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world exponential or function-transformation word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: sets up the exponential model with the growth/decay factor in the wrong position

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
